title: Large display and panoramic roof mentions
summary: This topic combines positive feedback about the large display and panoramic glass roof with many context-only mentions of vehicle size, trunk space, and roof preferences that do not clearly indicate sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the large display screen and panoramic glass roof as appealing interior features.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly mention the vehicle being large, trunk size, or preferences about the glass roof opening or sunlight without enough context to assign clear sentiment.

limitations: The topic is lexically broad because the word 'large' groups unrelated subjects such as body size, display size, trunk capacity, and glass roof comments.
Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence is limited for drawing a clear sentiment pattern beyond the explicitly positive display and roof comments.
Some undetermined fragments suggest possible preferences or dissatisfaction, but the provided sentiment assignments do not support reclassifying them.
